scope: Runtime-validated session, challenge, command, snapshot, acknowledgement, error, and result schemas
Opaque server-issued session tokens replacing caller-supplied Socket.IO identity
Origin, payload-size, rate, timeout, teardown, and replay guards
Schema, malformed-input, event-flood, and real Socket.IO client protocol tests
non_goals: Nimiq Pay SDK or real wallet signatures
skipped_checks: Physical Android and iOS testing: no release-testing environment was provided.
Nimiq Pay WebView and real wallet-provider testing: deferred to the external release environment and WP-011.
residual_risks: The bearer token remains readable by same-origin script, so CSP and XSS hardening remain required before production deployment.
An acknowledgement lost during initial anonymous session creation is not automatically recovered; rotation acknowledgement loss is covered.
Phone Chromium/WebKit projects emulate mobile browsers but cannot prove physical Nimiq Pay WebView behavior.
The client bundle remains approximately 1.34 MB minified and 370 kB gzip and emits the existing chunk-size warning.
